label: rem:color-tube-fibers-remark
title: Color tubes as color elliptic fibers
html: As schemes, the color tubes satisfy R_z \cong G_z \cong B_z, and each is isomorphic to the color fibre over z of color elliptic curve, the three roots of the color cubic, via the shift X = \mathbf{c} + z.
heading: Remark
